name: Big Charlotte Anime
blurb: An anime convention with voice-actor guests at the Charlotte Convention Center in Charlotte, North Carolina.

editions.evidence: Tickets page text: 'Saturday January 23rd' / 'Sunday January 24th' (confirmed as 2027 by weekday match and by a 'BIG-CHARLOTTE-ANIME-4X6-FLYER-2027' image); page title 'Big Charlotte Anime | Charlotte Convention Center'; web search corroborates Jan 23-24, 2027 at Charlotte Convention Center.

notes: Guest cards on the official /guests/ page show only a photo and name (alt text), no credits, so 'Known for' is left blank for all per RESEARCH.md; cat is 'voice' for all, confirmed by search results describing the lineup as 'voice over celebrities'. Skipped candidate #0 (site logo) and #8 ('Coming Soon' placeholder tile). The batch note's 'Jan 2026 edition was cancelled; summer edition still active' checks out but is moot for this file: that original Jan 24-25, 2026 date was weather-postponed to June 27-28, 2026, which already ended before the 2026-10-05 research window, so only the next confirmed edition (Jan 23-24, 2027) is listed. Organizer 'Big Texas Comicon, LLC' confirmed via the Tixr ticketing group URL (tixr.com/groups/bigtexas) and corroborated by a search result. Refute-pass (2026-10-05): refuted to none-yet -- neither the cached nor a fresh re-extraction (pipeline/cache/extract/big-charlotte-anime-v2.guests.json) shows any per-guest year/edition tag (cards carry only a name), and third-party coverage (rostercon.com's June-2026-dated listing) shows at least 3 of the 8 names (Christopher Wehkamp, Clifford Chapin, Kristen McGuire) already appeared at this con's last actual show, which ended June 28, 2026 (3 months ago); with no official announcement found naming any of the 8 for Jan 23-24, 2027 specifically, this reads as the still-posted prior lineup, not a new one.
